source_identity: workload.inventory_identity(design,protocol), full final source commit and code hashes
frozen_inputs: complete original design/protocol references and hashes; selected full bundle reference only for selected; fits=None exactly as existing run_pilot
target_reference: existing object_reference(work_dir/pilot-target-inventory/part), including raw payload/marker hashes and sizes
canonical_inventory_sha256: existing complete inventory hash, independently reconstructed on CPU
summary: exact counts, forward/operation counts and all original storage requirements; no optimistic subset
planned_geometry: original model/revision/tokenizer identities, hidden/head/layer dimensions, numeric profile, all widths/tiles and finish reserve
CPU_provenance: actual CPU run_manifest with normal completion, source before/after, input refs, timings and cgroup peak; producer has no model argument
not_serialized: validation booleans as a substitute for root anchoring
receiver_measurement: Separate immutable measurement reference anchored alongside this producer descriptor in the later root admission; not inserted retrospectively into an already completed producer descriptor and not a live lease.
